entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who sealed the rift over Shiv and is drained of all his powers, left mortal.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Ageless artificer who accompanies Teferi and goes to Skyshroud with Freyalise.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Artificer who builds a new ambulator, is linked to the Weaver King, and kills him.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Ageless wizard who came to Urborg to confront the Weaver King.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: Planeswalker protector of Urborg who seals the Urborg rift at the cost of fading from reality.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker protector of Skyshroud who sacrifices herself to close the rift.

entities.name: Weaver King
entities.description: A sadistic psychic vampire and shadow being, a former Dal nomad who joined Volrath; killed by Venser.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem planeswalker who travels into the past to seal the Tolarian rift and is corrupted.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Planeswalker protégé of Karn who arrives asking where her mentor is.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: Person Freyalise asks Jhoira to find in the Pardic Mountains to defend Skyshroud.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Cast Obliterate to destroy Tolaria.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Leader the Weaver King joined before the Invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders pouring from rifts from an alternate reality.

entities.name: Ghitu
entities.description: People of Shiv who help Venser build an ambulator.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Creatures of Skyshroud with a hive mind that Freyalise controls and the Weaver King seizes.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Continent whose rift Teferi sealed.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Land under siege from Phyrexians through a rift.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: Forest whose rift drains mana and lets Phyrexians through.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Former academy whose rift causes the alternate Phyrexians.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes where the planeswalkers meet and Karn flees.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Where the Weaver King was trapped during the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane suffering a temporal crisis.

entities.name: Ambulator
entities.description: Transport device Venser builds with the Ghitu.

entities.name: Temporal crisis of Dominaria
entities.description: The collapse of time and space on Dominaria.

events.summary: Teferi has sealed the rift over Shiv, returning the continent, but is drained of all powers; Jhoira and Venser take him to the Ghitu, who help Venser build a new ambulator.
events.quote: However, the effort has drained the planeswalker of all his powers and left him incapacitated.

events.summary: Jhoira and Venser go to Urborg to seek Lord Windgrace; Venser is captured by Windgrace and Jhoira meets Jodah, who explains the Weaver King.
events.quote: Venser is captured by Lord Windgrace while Jhoira encounters Jodah

events.summary: Windgrace consults Teferi, who deduces the Phyrexians come from an alternate reality; Windgrace takes the group to the Blind Eternities to meet Freyalise, and they decide to pursue the rifts independently.
events.quote: Windgrace and Freyalise decide to pursue each rift independently.

events.summary: In Skyshroud Freyalise uses the slivers' hive mind to beat back the Phyrexians and asks Jhoira to find Radha.
events.quote: She requests that Jhoira find Radha in the Pardic mountains

events.summary: The Weaver King follows Jodah and Venser to Skyshroud and takes control of the slivers and Phyrexians; Freyalise channels all her mana into the rift, closing it and consuming herself.
events.quote: closing it but completely consuming herself in the process.

events.summary: Karn arrives and convinces Windgrace to close the Urborg rift; Windgrace crushes the rift but fades from reality, apparently dead.
events.quote: he fades from reality as well, apparently dead.

events.summary: Venser tricks the Weaver King and kills him by rupturing powerstones.
events.quote: Venser utilizes his planeswalking abilities to trick the Weaver King and kill him

events.summary: Karn time travels to just before Barrin cast Obliterate and seals the Tolarian rift, but senses a dark corruption and flees across the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: proceeds to planeswalk randomly throughout the Blind Eternities to prevent anyone from following him.

events.summary: Jeska arrives in Urborg and asks where her mentor Karn is.
events.quote: The planeswalker protégé of Karn asks where her mentor is.

relations.quote: kill him by rupturing several powerstones he previously used in his artifice
The planeswalker protégé of Karn asks where her mentor is.

relations.note: Takes the powerless Teferi to Shiv.
relations.quote: Jhoira and Venser take Teferi to the Ghitu in Shiv
that joined Volrath before the Invasion
